title: Stance and its guard
situation: The architect repeatedly slides from meaning into realization when asked a conceptual question, caught by the operator each time; identity comes from an agent's definition and reach from whoever starts it, but nothing holds the dimensions the operator sets firm. The operator's direction is an append-only record of those settings that a guard reads at the moment of each check, with enforcement levels in the manner of policy stores (advisory, soft-mandatory, hard-mandatory).
decision: Realize stance and the stance guard: the operator's settings recorded as entries, the guard reading the current stance at each act and enforcing it as firmly as it holds.
consequences: Not yet illustrated; the operator develops it further first. Depends on agent launch. Its examples must include what the guard must not block.
